verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents an official MCP server that connects Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client to the user's account. It ships as an installable npm package (@porkbunllc/mcp-server) with 96 tools covering domain registration, DNS, hosting and Cloudflare moves, and a probe confirms the dedicated /mcp page is live. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The official Porkbun MCP server connects Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client straight to your account.
npx @porkbunllc/mcp-server — 96 tools for Claude, Cursor and any MCP client.
official MCP server documented at https://porkbun.com/mcp
